s1.desc: a dining nook drawn on a plain pale grey background

spans.view: with a round cream table set with plates of food between them and two wooden chairs

beats.text: Pax laughs with his eyes closed, looking down at {ifin}, while Polly bites a little sandwich with her eyes shut happily
Pax grins down at the phone while Polly chews and glances over at him
Pax reaches across the table and shows Polly {ifin}
Polly lowers her sandwich and stares at the phone with a flat face while Pax holds it up, watching her

spans.notes: v4 called this a slow push-in; feature matching gives scale 0.9998 and shift 0.1 px over f0-51 and the table and chair edges overlap in compare 0/51, so the camera is locked. The phone screen shows a zooming planet video (no lead).

spans.view: with a plate of curly fries and sandwiches on the table in front of her and a wooden chair behind

beats.text: Polly stares at the back of {ifin}, held out to her from the left
Polly blinks slowly with a flat, unimpressed face
Polly keeps staring at the phone with wide, unmoving eyes and a blank, unimpressed beak

spans.notes: Only Pax's flipper is in the picture, holding the phone at the left edge, so Pax is not listed as a character. Back of the phone clearly shows the iFin (three lenses, tuft).
17 frames: Pax holds up the phone, whose screen shows a video of a round penguin in Pax's colours
Polly close-up, slow zoom in for the whole shot (scale 1.074 over f106-155, steady per-frame drift)
Pax laughing with tears and tapping, camera locked, but he holds the phone screen toward the viewer and it plays a video of a round penguin drawn in Pax's colours and style for the whole shot
Polly close-up: slow zoom in f218-240 (scale 1.039), then a fast zoom back out f241-245
15 static frames of Polly chuckling behind her flipper after the zoom
19 frames: Pax with the phone (screen video of a Pax-like penguin)
